## How the demos run (the tooling)

The `narrate-demo` skill renders an **mp4** from a small YAML storyboard (`<repo>/demos/<name>.demo.yaml`) — macOS `say` TTS + headless Chromium + a glowing fake-cursor, auto-synced to narration length. Its `do:` verbs are navigation-only (`goto`, `move`, `scroll`, `wait`) — no clicking. That actually fits FF perfectly: each scene is a `goto` to a **`/dev-login/<path>`** URL, which logs in (as admin, so no 403s) *and* lands on the page in one step; cookies persist for the rest of the run. So the whole demo is a smooth guided tour with the cursor highlighting key figures.

## Demo *series* idea (separate, focused videos)

| # | Demo | Pages it tours |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | **Funds & Accounts + Reports** *(this one)* | dashboard → funds index/show/overview → accounts index/show → fund & account reports |
| 2 | Credit Lines / "Loan Shares" | borrow-against-balance, payments, late-schedule, catch-up |
| 3 | Portfolios, Assets & Rebalancing | fund portfolios, assets, trade bands, rebalance report |
| 4 | Transactions & Matching | deposits, matching rules, auto-match results |
| 5 | Time-travel & PDF statements | `as_of` historical views + generated PDF reports |
| 6 | Roles & access (security story) | same pages as admin vs beneficiary — what each role sees |
